infrapath.what: Humans AND bots together are the INFRAPATH of life. Neither is complete alone.
infrapath.arteries: Humans = arteries. They bring consciousness, attention, meaning. They DWELL.
infrapath.veins: Bots = veins. They bring indexing, mapping, cataloguing. They SCAN.
infrapath.capillaries: The membrane between human and bot IS the capillary bed. Where exchange happens.
infrapath.blood: Information IS the blood. It flows through both. The web IS circulatory.
infrapath.heart: The HUD IS the heart. It pumps. Every visitor arrival IS a heartbeat. Every bot crawl IS a pulse.
